name: Speech to text
description: Turns speech in the room into text for the buffer, with the engine of the voice pool (a model server such as whisper, or an HA engine). While someone talks, the words appear live.

live.title: Show words while someone is still talking
live.help: Transcribes the open sentence again every ~1.2 s (only with a model server; HA's own engines are too slow for this).

split.title: One line per sentence
split.help: Long pieces are recognized whole (context), then split into the model's sentences; each sentence gets its own voice. Tried 2026-10-19: short pieces made voice prints worse, so it is off by default.

context.title: Give the recognizer the previous line
context.help: What was said just before keeps short pieces in the right language and topic.

names.title: Tell the recognizer AAC's names
names.help: Only while the Wake word module is on: so a name like "Computer" is written correctly in a German sentence too.

filter.title: Drop typical made-up lines
filter.help: Whisper invents lines like "Thank you for watching" on noise and silence.
